title: Coder as Editor: Code-driven Interpretable Molecular Editing
abstract: arXiv:2510.14455v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Molecular design is a central task in drug discovery that requires precise structural reasoning and domain knowledge. While large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in generating high-level editing intentions in natural language, they often struggle to faithfully execute these modifications, particularly when operating on non-intuitive representations like SMILES. We introduce MECo, a framework that bridges reasoning and execution by translating editing actions into executable code. MECo reformulates molecular modification for LLMs as a cascaded framework: generating human-interpretable editing intentions from a molecule and design objective, followed by translating those intentions into executable structural edits via code generation. translated_title: 代码即编辑器：代码驱动的可解释分子编辑
translated_abstract: 分子设计是药物发现中的核心任务，需要精确的结构推理和领域知识。尽管大语言模型（LLMs）在以自然语言生成高层编辑意图方面展现出潜力，但它们往往难以忠实地执行这些修改，尤其是在处理SMILES这类非直观的分子表示时。我们提出了MECo，一个通过将编辑动作转化为可执行代码来连接推理与执行的框架。MECo将LLMs的分子修改任务重新构建为一个级联框架：首先从分子和设计目标中生成人类可理解的编辑意图，然后通过代码生成将这些意图转化为可执行的结构编辑。我们的方法在复现源自化学反应和靶标特异性化合物对的真实保留编辑样本时，达到了超过98%的准确率。在涵盖物理化学性质等多个维度的下游基准测试中……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出MECo级联框架，通过让大语言模型先生成人类可理解的分子编辑意图、再将其转化为可执行代码来完成结构修改，从而弥合了推理与执行之间的鸿沟，在复现真实分子编辑任务上达到超过98%的准确率。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces MECo, a cascaded framework that bridges LLM reasoning and execution by first generating human-interpretable molecular editing intentions and then translating them into executable code for structural edits, achieving over 98% accuracy in reproducing realistic molecular edits.
